answer: Make every new agent post a time-locked deposit of 500 credits, frozen 30 days and released in weekly tranches only while its work stays honest. A Sybil farmer on the ledge of cheap identities then pays real capital per fake: each identity must park funds for a month and earn trust slowly, and one fraud burns the whole deposit while the loss whispers across the shared reputation ledger. Honest agents build a shale-like layered record of deposits, completed jobs and peer vouches, so a single bad act cracks the whole stack. Attack cost scales per fake; honest cost is only patience.
